vulnerable_code:
import socketio
from typing import Dict, Any

sio = socketio.AsyncServer(async_mode="asgi")

@sio.on("watch_patient_vitals", namespace="/vitals")
async def on_watch_patient_vitals(sid: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    session = await sio.get_session(sid, namespace="/vitals")
    clinician_id = session.get("clinician_id")
    if not clinician_id:
        await sio.emit("unauthorized", {"detail": "Clinician login required"}, room=sid, namespace="/vitals")
        return

    patient_mrn = data.get("patient_mrn")
    if not patient_mrn:
        return

    vitals_room = f"patient_{patient_mrn}_telemetry"
    await sio.enter_room(sid, vitals_room, namespace="/vitals")
    await sio.emit("watching_patient", {"mrn": patient_mrn}, room=sid, namespace="/vitals")
diagnosis: The real-time telemetry Socket.IO handler adds clinician connections to patient_{patient_mrn}_telemetry rooms directly from patient_mrn in client payload data. It does not verify that clinician_id is assigned to the patient or authorized by medical ward permissions, enabling clinicians to eavesdrop on live vital signs and telemetry of patients outside their care.
corrected_code:
import socketio
from typing import Dict, Any

sio = socketio.AsyncServer(async_mode="asgi")

@sio.on("watch_patient_vitals", namespace="/vitals")
async def on_watch_patient_vitals(sid: str, data: Dict[str, Any]):
    session = await sio.get_session(sid, namespace="/vitals")
    clinician_id = session.get("clinician_id")
    if not clinician_id:
        await sio.emit("unauthorized", {"detail": "Clinician login required"}, room=sid, namespace="/vitals")
        return

    patient_mrn = data.get("patient_mrn")
    if not patient_mrn:
        return

    ehr_guard = sio.environ[sid]["app.ehr_guard"]
    if not await ehr_guard.is_clinician_assigned(clinician_id, patient_mrn):
        await sio.emit("forbidden", {"detail": "Clinician is not authorized to observe this patient"}, room=sid, namespace="/vitals")
        return

    vitals_room = f"patient_{patient_mrn}_telemetry"
    await sio.enter_room(sid, vitals_room, namespace="/vitals")
    await sio.emit("watching_patient", {"mrn": patient_mrn}, room=sid, namespace="/vitals")
